text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Tokai Stakes.<n>Shinko Windy
uses her "darkness<n>switch" to heighten her focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Honing in on her urge to win, she<n>locks eyes on the
finish line and<n>blocks out the spectators and other
racers.
